prompts.palace: Use case: ads-marketing. Asset type: a continuous-scroll campaign scene for Cheeta Jewels, landscape 16:9, 2560x1440 if possible. Full chest visible, slightly elevated camera looking into the burgundy velvet tray. IMPORTANT: the tray is ONE SINGLE LONG EMPTY eyewear recess, no partitions, NO glasses, no accessories inside. We will place exactly one frame into it in the website. Preserve brass clasp, rich dark wood, feet and burgundy velvet, the Cheeta Jewels identity in the inner lid. Case sits physically on a single broad pale marble ledge that continues out of both edges of the image near the lower edge, no display plinth. No palace room clutter, no curtains, plants, lamps, candles, books, weapons, people, gilded wall ornament or busy patterned floor. Palette mostly warm off-white stone, the box provides dark wood and burgundy. Editorial luxury still-life photograph, real material detail, natural soft directional daylight from upper left, subtle physical contact shadow, clean architecture, 50mm perspective. Keep upper left and upper right stone surfaces quiet for small HTML copy. No added typography, labels, graphics, grain, fog, glow, gradients, vignette, watermark. This is provisional campaign scenography, not an actual venue claim. Opaque complete photograph, not transparent.
